describe: change how an existing chart looks: its title, labels, colours, size, sorting, or add a trend line
guide: Change the chart that is already drawn rather than adding a new one: find its axes.set_title, set_xlabel/set_ylabel, figsize, colours or sort in analysis.py and edit those lines. The house style comes from matplotlibrc -- never call sns.set_theme() or plt.style.use().

A trend line needs `import numpy as np` at the top of the file (check it is there before using np), then slope, start = np.polyfit(x, y, 1) and axes.plot(x, slope * x + start). Rotated labels are plt.setp(axes.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha="right").
